decisions.boundary_condition: Treat the preference as a flexible later-day window ranging from afternoon to after 6:00 p.m., not as a fixed cutoff
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon or evening return departures when workable
decisions.condition: When selecting a return flight and multiple departure times are available
decisions.default_action: Prioritize return options departing in the afternoon or evening
decisions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when the traveler explicitly requests it for the current trip or no later-day option is workable
decisions.name: Prefer later-day return flights
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples support a recurring preference for later-day return departures. The evidence varies between afternoon, evening, and after 6:00 p.m., so this remains a soft time-of-day default rather than a fixed cutoff.
